public_todo_tests.source: python -m pytest -q tests/test_todos.py, final check after screenshot integration; 31 passed.

exposure_source: SinD four public sample records; 0/1938, nominal Wilson upper bound used as a conservative transfer assumption.
exposure_unit: eligible observed car passage; not complete journey
limitations: Data-derived exposure is a conservative nominal bound, not a calibrated whole-journey frequency for town A.
screenshot_provenance: Four original PNG screenshots provided by the user and preserved byte-for-byte.
snapshot_timing_limitations: UI displays rounded times in the bus baseline, fix and bicycle screenshots; exact event times are disclosed in REPORT.md.
delivery: Repository commit and GitHub push; duplicate package, ZIP and large CSV cache archived outside the repository.
